base.reason: Headless native Agent; add native development consumers and scoped domain presets

roles.meta: native development, native research delegation, human questions and business writes
roles.research: native continuable session in shared activity work/session; query-only business tools; same research trust domain as main
roles.reviewer: independent work/session and authoritative review output; no business writes or delegation

capacity.persistentWorkspaceQuota: host filesystem capacity; no enforced per-activity quota yet
capacity.outputBytesScope: shared activity research Runner; independent stop-review Runner
capacity.researchDeadline: activity deadline; no additional child lifetime timeout
capacity.childPublicationBytesScope: isolated stop reviewer only; research files remain directly accessible

restrictions.network: disabled in Runner; only host-controlled model/accounting and material services
restrictions.mcp: Meta has no configured external MCP connections; Solver task MCP is unchanged
restrictions.office: headless profile excludes optional office rendering payloads
restrictions.human: blocking native ask-user; question/answer persists independently of UI connection
restrictions.processRecovery: files and native session persist; OS processes are terminated and output marked interrupted

receipts.activeScope: meta_sessions.agents; tools are captured from the actual Agent scope

delegation.researchCwd: native explicit/inherited directory; not a permission boundary
delegation.researchRecovery: native durable catalog and session; list_agents then send_message to resume the same child; reconcile interrupted work
delegation.researchIsolation: independent context, shared activity process/files; no OS isolation from main
delegation.reviewIsolation: separate process/container, workspace, session and host-bound identity
